title: Wending Subtleties
description: Adds some minimal additions to vanilla world generation, with the goal of making things feel just a little more complete.
body:
**What is Wending Subtleties?**

Wending Subtleties is a small datapack project focused on adding minimal additions and consistency changes to vanilla world generation, with the main goal of making Minecraft's overworld and subsequent dimensions feel just a little more finished. I've really enjoyed working on this project, and I hope that this is what you have been looking for!!

**Wending Subtleties v26.7.8 for 26.2**

- Added full support for the 26.2 Chaos Cubed drop.
- Changed the pack icon to reflect the current drops theme \*nom nom nom!*
- Fabric support soon, I'll get to that in a bit!

![A shot of a player running away from a sulfur spring while holding a bucket of captured Sulfur Cubes, with the backdrop of an upgraded swamp.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d77000b60cbaf68e2b044a4eefbcb69e45be66da.png)

**--Worldgen Changes--**

**Configured Feature Changes:**

Large tree variants

- All large tree variants have an increased minimum height to fix those pesky “bulb” trees. The maximum size has stayed the same.

**Biome Changes:**

Forest
- Large leaf litter birch tree variant
- Grass generates at a higher density

Birch Forest/Old Growth Birch Forest
- Large birch tree variant
- Grass generates at a higher density

Dark Forest
- Large leaf litter birch tree variant
- Grass generates at a higher density
  
Flower Forest
- All trees now feature leaf litter
- Large leaf litter birch tree variant
- Grass now uses forest density

Plains
- Birch trees
- Large birch tree variant

River
- Grass generates at a higher density
- Tall grass also generates

Swamp
- Large swamp tree variant
- Mud generates on shorelines/low areas

Windswept Hills/Gravelly Hills
- Grass now generates at a higher density
- Ferns can now be found mixed in
- Large leaf litter oak tree variant
- Small oak trees now feature leaf litter

Windswept Forest
- Grass generates at a higher density
- Ferns can now be found mixed in
- Large leaf litter oak tree variant
- Small oak trees now feature leaf litter

Savanna
- Large oak tree variant

Windswept Savanna
- Large leaf litter oak tree variant
- Small oak trees now feature leaf litter
- Grass now uses regular savanna density

Jungle/Bamboo Jungle
- Trees have been moved apart a bit to ease congestion
- Bushes now have a slightly higher rarity

Wooded Badlands
- Large leaf litter oak tree variant

Taiga
- Grass now generates at a higher density

Old Growth Pine/Spruce Taiga
- Boulders now generate at a lower density

Snowy Plains
- Ferns now generate
- Berry bushes can now be found rarely
- All regular taiga tree variants can now be found
- Cows, Pigs, Sheep, and Chickens now have the ability to spawn, their rarities matching the Snowy Taiga

Snowy Beach/Frozen River
 - Berry bushes can now be found rarely

Lush Caves
- Grass and Foliage colors now match moss more closely

All Nether Biomes
- Fog is now tuned to be more atmospheric, with substantially increased visibility
